name: China Blue
source:
Min is a debt collector. Her target is a big boss. She defeats three his kempo style fighting bodyguards, but gets injury as well. She decides to approach her target by using a trick...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]

敏是一名讨债人，这次的目标是一位大老板。她击败了对方三名精通拳法的保镖，自己也因此受伤。为了接近目标，她决定使出一条计策……
